title: Transcription Service
requirements: Call SpeechTranscriber first; fall back to WhisperClient on: empty text, <50% expected length, Speech error, or recognition exceeding 3× audio duration
On fallback also failing, yield TranscriptUpdate.failed; retain audio on disk
No more than one engine runs at a time
acceptance_criteria: Falls back to Whisper when Speech returns empty text
Hang protection triggers when recognition exceeds 3× audio duration
